_README: EDIT THIS FILE FREELY. It is the human half of the strategy catalogue.
Everything factual about a strategy -- entries, exits, indicators, gate results -- is
derived from source and measurement, and anything you write here that contradicts the
code is overwritten on the next build. What lives here is judgement: why something
failed, what was already tried, what to do next. No parser produces that.
Keyed by strategy name, exactly as it appears in the catalogue. Fields are free-form --
add your own and they pass through to the dashboard untouched. Suggested ones:
why_it_failed   the honest one-line reason, with numbers where they exist
what_was_tried  so nobody repeats a dead end
next_step       or null if it is finished
Published to telemetry/s1_analytics.json on the next analytics run. A malformed file
is ignored with a warning rather than breaking the publish -- it can never take the
System 2, System 3 and the dashboard may all read this. Any of them may propose edits.

liquidity_grab_fade.why_it_failed: Has not failed -- currently one of three qualified. But it qualified on 13 out-of-sample trades with PF 8.28 and a 0.05% max drawdown, which is what a small sample looks like rather than an established edge.
liquidity_grab_fade.what_was_tried: Qualified under the OOS gate lowered from 60 months to 12 on 2026-08-21 by owner decision. There is no minimum trade-count gate, which is how a 13-trade cell passed.
liquidity_grab_fade.next_step: Watch live. System 3's sizing prior gives it NEGATIVE expectancy (-0.0517), so it will suppress or refuse sizing regardless of the headline PF.

macd_divergence.why_it_failed: Has not failed -- qualified. On 20 out-of-sample trades with PF 13.58 and a 0.02% max drawdown. Treat the profit factor as an artefact of sample size.
macd_divergence.next_step: System 3's prior expectancy is +0.0011, effectively zero, so expect approved-then-tiny rather than meaningful size.

weekly_day_reversal_ea.why_it_failed: Has not failed -- qualified on 5 out-of-sample trades. Five.
weekly_day_reversal_ea.next_step: The only one of the three whose sizing prior (+0.4764) will produce a meaningful position. Also the thinnest evidence. Both are true.

Range_Stochastic_Divergence.why_it_failed: Look-ahead. Divergence detection used a centred rolling window (range_stochastic.py:245,248,281,284), so it read the future. Computed causally it emits ZERO signals. Its reported PF 1.92 / Sharpe 1.07 were fiction.
Range_Stochastic_Divergence.what_was_tried: It was the entire live model across four cells until FIX-S1-014. Regenerating the map would NOT have removed it -- the attribution rows derived from look-ahead outcomes, so a fresh vet would have re-qualified it. It is barred by an explicit integrity blocklist checked before the performance gates.

currency_momentum_factor.why_it_failed: Scored PF 0.89 / Sharpe -0.42 over 300 trades -- but that verdict is on a mutilated version. Its headline mechanism is a cross-pair ranking, and the harness passes one pair at a time with no pair identity, so the rank filter was unreachable and the module degenerated to absolute momentum.
currency_momentum_factor.what_was_tried: Re-measured properly via src/portfolio/ as a portfolio rather than per-cell: full-sample Sharpe 0.07, OOS -0.12. Flat, but it beats the -0.42, which confirms the single-pair scoring destroyed real information.
currency_momentum_factor.next_step: Five currencies leave four active legs (net_tercile_weights sends the median to 0.0) and the published effect is a breadth effect. Needs a wider universe to be a fair test.

demark_fractal_breakout.why_it_failed: Its USD_JPY H4 cell was the single best result in the whole 47-strategy exercise -- 610 OOS trades, PF 1.51, Sharpe 1.11, clearing every gate. Debunked: a pip-conversion bug (commit 2d3b432).
demark_fractal_breakout.what_was_tried: It was the last surviving candidate for M2. Its failure is why M2 is not reached.

nnfx_backtrader.why_it_failed: Pooled PF 1.63 / Sharpe 0.94 -- on 113 trades with 0 of 5 cells passing and a best cell resting on 16 trades. A concentration artefact.
nnfx_backtrader.what_was_tried: Has two unreconciled harness runs. Do not cite it as a qualifier until someone reconciles them.

strong_weak_analysis.why_it_failed: PF 1.24 / Sharpe 0.36 over 295 trades -- but like currency_momentum_factor, its strength-rank gate was unreachable one pair at a time. What was measured is a trend-plus-pullback skeleton, not the strategy its author described.
strong_weak_analysis.next_step: Re-measure through src/portfolio/ now that pair-keyed bundles exist.

daily_fib_retracement.why_it_failed: Not measured, despite having a row. It emitted 254 orders and the engine admitted none of them.
daily_fib_retracement.what_was_tried: Counted among the 'finished and accepted 15' and never flagged.
daily_fib_retracement.next_step: Fix the order construction before drawing any conclusion about the idea.
